label: Morning Brief
timezoneNote: All times shown in ET (America/New_York). Index levels labelled 'close' are Oct 26 regular-session closes (TradingKey); futures and 10Y yield are from a Yahoo Finance live-blog snapshot taken between roughly 6:00 and 7:40 AM ET (exact tick time not stated); crypto are early-morning snapshots with times noted. Economic-data release times were not stated by the source and are omitted.

driver.text: US futures are modestly higher after Monday's rally, which was led by chips (SOX +2.8%, all 30 members up) after Anthropic publicly filed its S-1 to list on Nasdaq as ANT (H1 2026 revenue $16.3B; roadshow expected as early as the week of Nov 9). Oil eased on Middle East diplomacy hopes (WTI ~$101-102, Brent ~$115.5-116) but Brent stays near six-month highs after attacks on Saudi Arabia. The Fed's two-day meeting began today, with a hold expected and about 10% odds of a hike priced; the decision comes Wednesday. Big-tech earnings (Alphabet, Microsoft) are Wednesday after the close. Asia was weak in China (Shanghai -1.33%, Shenzhen -2.50%) and strong in Japan (Nikkei +1.73%).

items.headline: Mizuho trims Circle target to $43 (Underperform), warns AI assistants could steer cash away from USDC
items.summary: Mizuho's tests found AI assistants tend to recommend higher-yielding, FDIC-insured alternatives to USDC; it estimates 10-20% of Circle's reserve revenue and $4-9B of USDC market cap could be at risk over the medium term (potential effects, not measured losses). CRCL fell 7.2% Monday to $79.72 alongside weak crypto; it was down about 1% premarket. ARK bought ~$5.2M of CRCL on Monday.

items.headline: ARK Invest buys $5.2M of Circle shares, trims its Bitcoin ETF, as BTC slips below $80K
items.summary: ARKW added ~65,615 CRCL shares on Monday after the 7% drop; ARK sold ~$15.9M of its own bitcoin ETF, attributed to rebalancing. Bitcoin is ~8.7% below its October high, a sentiment headwind for CRCL; Coinbase earnings Oct 29 are the next read-through.

items.headline: ETH pinned near $2,300 lower Bollinger band; sellers dominate execution ahead of Fed
items.summary: ETH traded ~$2,304 (-0.81% in 24h, range $2,296-$2,345), RSI 32 and below all short/medium-term moving averages; open interest fell ~2%. A break below ~$2,290 would target ~$2,240. Technical read, not a fundamental catalyst; ETHA tracks ETH directly.

items.headline: Stablecoin balance on Ethereum down $2.9B (2%) in 30 days, falling for a third straight month
items.summary: DefiLlama data cited by CryptoTicker shows ~$143.1B of stablecoins on Ethereum, 14.7% below the Nov 2025 peak, with Tron second at $93.9B. Shrinking on-chain stablecoin liquidity is a modest negative for ETH demand and fee activity.

items.headline: Nvidia to invest $3B in Meta's equity offering and expand AI partnership (Vera Rubin, Vera CPUs)
items.summary: Meta raised its planned stock offering to as much as $97.5B; Nvidia plans $3B of it and Meta will use Nvidia's Vera Rubin platform and Vera CPUs. Positive for demand visibility but also continues the 'Nvidia as AI financier' debate. NVDA was +0.54% premarket at $217.16. TradingKey separately reported Nvidia and Broadcom expressed non-binding interest in up to $5B combined.

items.headline: Chip stocks surge as Anthropic files for Nasdaq IPO; SOX +2.82% with all 30 members higher
items.summary: Anthropic's S-1 (H1 2026 revenue $16.3B, ~14x year over year) revived the AI trade and led the semiconductor rally. Valuation and AI-debt-funding doubts remain, so the move could reverse on Alphabet/Microsoft capex commentary Wednesday.

items.headline: Barclays upgrades Tesla to Overweight, target $450; stock jumped 5.2% to $391.62 Monday
items.summary: Barclays cites a robotaxi miles inflection, FSD on >75% of new North American Teslas in Q3, an energy business nearly sold out for 2027 and a potential SpaceX merger. No merger agreement exists; Tesla and SpaceX have formed committees and any deal would need shareholder approval.
items.pubTime: Oct 27, 2026 (time not stated; Monday close data)

items.headline: Alphabet down ~1% premarket ahead of Wednesday's Q3 report; AI capex and Cloud backlog in focus
items.summary: GOOG was -0.97% in Yahoo's snapshot while Microsoft rose 1.5%. Alphabet reports after the close Wednesday Oct 28; consensus EPS ~$3.00 and revenue ~$127.85B. Pre-earnings coverage flags a $514B Cloud backlog, a sharply higher capex path and negative free cash flow last quarter, so capex and Cloud growth are the swing factors. Fed decision the same afternoon.
items.sourceName: Yahoo Finance live blog; 24/7 Wall St.

items.headline: Banks line up $63B financing for Anthropic's Broadcom-based AI compute; AVGO +2.3% premarket
items.summary: BofA, Blackstone, Citi and Morgan Stanley announced a $63B structure to fund Broadcom custom AI accelerators (XPUs) and networking gear that Anthropic will lease, with deliveries from 2027. It validates the order pipeline, but Broadcom will provide residual value support equal to the first-lien debt, adding financial exposure. AVGO was $336.71 premarket.
